title: Rapid and specific detection of Trichophyton rubrum and Trichophyton mentagrophytes using a loop-mediated isothermal amplification assay
author: Seo, Kim, et al.
materials: The two positive control strains T. rubrum and T. mentagrophytes and eight non-Trichophyton fungal species (Epidermophyton floccosum, Microsporum canis, Aspergillus fumigatus, Aspergillus niger, Candida albicans, Candida glabrata, Fusarium solani, and Cryptococcus neoformans) were purchased from the Korean Collection for Type Cultures (KCTC; Jeollabukdo, Korea) and the National Culture Collection for Pathogens (Osong, Korea).Genomic DNA was extracted using a MasterPure Yeast Purification Kit (Epicentre Biotechnologies, Madison, WI, USA) as follows: (i) lysis buffer was added to the samples and vortexed with for 1min; (ii) the treated samples were centrifuged at 13,000 rpm for 10min and supernatant was transferred to a new microcentrifuge tube; (iii) 1 microliter RNase A (100 micrograms/microliter) was added to the supernatant and incubated at 65°C for 15min; (iv) the samples were kept on ice for 5min and MPC protein Precipitation Reagent was added; (v) centrifuged at 13,000 rpm for 10min and supernatant was transferred to a new microcentrifuge tube; (vi) isopropanol was added and centrifuged at 13,000 rpm for 10 min; (vii) the pellet was washed with 70% ethanol; (viii) the nucleic acids were finally eluted with 50 µl of TE buffer. The concentration was determined using NanoDrop 1000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., Waltham, MA, USA). The extracted genomic DNA was used as a template for LAMP. The internal transcribed spacer 1 (ITS1) region of the rDNA of T. rubrum and T. mentagrophytes was PCR-amplified and ligated into RBC T&A cloning vectors (Real Biotech Corporation, Banqiao, Taiwan).

The LAMP reaction was carried out as described previously, with some modifications [20,21,23,24]. Briefly, the 20 µl LAMP reaction mixture contained 2 µl of 10X Isothermal Amplification buffer (New England Biolabs, Ipswich, MA, USA), 1.5 mM of each deoxynucleotide triphosphate, 6 mM MgSO4, 8U of Bst 2.0 DNA polymerase, 1.25 µM of SYTO9 (Thermo Fisher Scientific), and 2 µl of T. rubrum (or T. mentabrophytes DNA template. The composition of the T. rubrum and T. mentagrophytes LAMP primer mix included 0.2 µM of the outer primers (F3 and B3), 1.6 µM of the inner primers (FIP and BIP), and 0.4 µM of loop primer (LB). The amplification reaction was performed at 60°C for 45 min and terminated by heating at 80°C for 3 min using a CFX96 Touch Real-Time PCR Detection System (Bio-Rad Laboratories, Hercules, CA, USA). The fluorescence curve was captured using Bio-Rad CFX Manager.

Toenail specimens from 19 fungus microscopy test-positive patients, diagnosed by a board-certified dermatologist, were collected from Uijeongbu St. Mary's Hospital (Gyeonggi-do, Korea) between August to November 2021. The study design was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Catholic Medical Center (UIRB-면20210716-002). Fungal DNA was extracted using a QIAamp DNA Mini Kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The extracted genomic DNA was used as a template for the LAMP assay. Before LAMP, the genomic DNA was amplified using primers designed to amplify the full ITS sequence as described elsewhere [25]: 05-forward primer (5′-GATTGAATGGCTTAGTGAGG-3′) and its_05-reverse primer (5′-TTGTTCGCTATCGGTCTC-3′; Fig. 1A). The PCR products were sequenced via Sanger sequencing, and the sequencing results were evaluated using BLAST (https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi) to determine the closest relatives on the NCBI website (http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov).

steps.title: Obtain fungal strains
steps.instruction: Purchase two positive control strains (T. rubrum and T. mentagrophytes) and eight non‑Trichophyton species (Epidermophyton floccosum, Microsporum canis, Aspergillus fumigatus, Aspergillus niger, Candida albicans, Candida glabrata, Fusarium solani, Cryptococcus neoformans) from the Korean Collection for Type Cultures (KCTC) and the National Culture Collection for Pathogens (Osong).

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from each fungal culture using the MasterPure Yeast Purification Kit following the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Add lysis buffer to the sample and vortex for 1 min.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 min; transfer supernatant to a new tube.
Add 1 µl RNase A (100 µg/µl) to the supernatant and incubate at 65 °C for 15 min.
Place on ice for 5 min and add MPC protein precipitation reagent.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 min; transfer supernatant to a new tube.
Add isopropanol, mix, and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 min.
Elute nucleic acids with 50 µl TE buffer.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a NanoDrop 1000 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Clone ITS1 region
steps.instruction: PCR‑amplify the ITS1 region of T. rubrum and T. mentagrophytes and ligate the amplicons into RBC T&A cloning vectors (Real Biotech).

steps.title: Design LAMP primers
steps.instruction: Retrieve ITS1 sequences (GenBank JX431933 for T. rubrum, MH791418 for T. mentagrophytes) using BioEdit v7.2, design LAMP primers (F3, B3, FIP, BIP, LB) with Primer Explorer V5 and manual curation, include a TTTT spacer in FIP and BIP, and validate each primer set by BLAST.

steps.title: Prepare LAMP reaction
steps.instruction: Set up a 20 µl LAMP mixture containing 2 µl 10X Isothermal Amplification buffer (NEB), 1.5 mM each dNTP, 6 mM MgSO₄, 8 U Bst 2.0 DNA polymerase, 1.25 µM SYTO 9, 2 µl DNA template, and a primer mix of 0.2 µM outer primers (F3, B3), 1.6 µM inner primers (FIP, BIP), and 0.4 µM loop primer (LB).

steps.title: Run LAMP amplification
steps.instruction: Place reactions in a CFX96 Touch Real‑Time PCR Detection System, incubate at 60 °C for 45 min, then terminate by heating at 80 °C for 3 min; capture fluorescence curves with Bio‑Rad CFX Manager.

steps.title: Optimize LAMP conditions
steps.instruction: Test the following variables to determine the optimal reaction: LB primer concentrations (0.2, 0.3, 0.4 µM), temperatures (60, 63, 65 °C), Bst polymerase units (4, 6, 8, 10 U), dNTP concentrations (1.0, 1.2, 1.4, 1.6, 1.8 mM), and MgSO₄ concentrations (4, 6, 8 mM). Use nuclease‑free water as a negative control.

steps.title: Determine detection limit
steps.instruction: Serially dilute genomic DNA from 1 ng/µl down to 100 fg/µl, run each dilution in the optimized LAMP reaction, and repeat each reaction three times to establish the limit of detection.

steps.title: Assess assay specificity
steps.instruction: Perform the optimized LAMP reaction with DNA from the eight non‑Trichophyton fungi listed above, include a nuclease‑free water control, and repeat each reaction three times to confirm lack of cross‑reactivity.

steps.title: Extract DNA from clinical samples
steps.instruction: Collect 19 KOH‑positive toenail specimens, extract fungal DNA using the QIAamp DNA Mini Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Amplify full ITS for sequencing
steps.instruction: PCR‑amplify the entire ITS region using primers 05‑forward (5′‑GATTGAATGGCTTAGTGAGG‑3′) and 05‑reverse (5′‑TTGTTCGCTATCGGTCTC‑3′).

steps.title: Sequence and identify isolates
steps.instruction: Submit PCR products for Sanger sequencing, then analyse the sequences with BLAST to determine the closest fungal species.

steps.title: Apply LAMP to clinical DNA
steps.instruction: Run the optimized LAMP assay on the extracted clinical DNA samples; interpret fluorescence curves to call each specimen positive or negative for T. rubrum or T. mentagrophytes.

description: Five LAMP primers targeting the ITS1 region of T. rubrum and T. mentagrophytes were designed: two inner primers (FIP and BIP), two outer primers (F3 and B3), and one loop primer (LB) (Fig. 1b and 1c). To validate whether the primer sets worked properly, we applied the T. rubrum and T. mentagrophytes LAMP primer sets to the DNA of reference T. rubrum and T. mentagrophytes under the conditions described elsewhere (60°C for 45 min) [23,24] and confirmed that both LAMP primer sets could amplify the reference DNA (data not shown).
